rules.title: clank is synchronous by construction
rules.text: PROTOCOL invariants 1 and 5: one invocation is one request in one process, and there is no concurrency inside it; parallelism is `xargs -P`, above clank. An async runtime is a second scheduler inside a stage that promised to be one step.

judgement.question: Does this line make clank's own code asynchronous — an `async` item, an `.await`, or a call into an async runtime — rather than a doc comment or a string that only names async?

criteria.true: the line itself is async by construction: an `async` item, an `.await` expression, or a call into an async runtime
criteria.false: it is inside a doc comment, a string literal, or a test that only mentions the word
